## History

John Fairlie spent twenty years courting [Thora](../character/thora.md), during which he took her and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to meet his invalid mother, who hinted at his and Thora's future together. After being coldly rejected by [Thora](../character/thora.md) following a prayer meeting, John's mother passed away shortly thereafter. Following his mother's funeral, John finally proposed to [Thora](../character/thora.md) and revealed that his mother had secretly forced him to vow not to marry while she was alive, after which [Thora](../character/thora.md) accepted his proposal.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Fairlie P2](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0002), [v3 ch.Fairlie P10](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0010), [v3 ch.Fairlie P16](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0016), [v3 ch.Fairlie P29](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0029), [v3 ch.Coming” P0](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0000), [v3 ch.Coming” P8](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0008), +6 more_
